statement._text: Greetings, [PlayerName]. Is something the matter?
I’d like to talk.
I want to train with you.
What do I need to learn to survive in the wild?
I’m going outside.
I’m going outside.
Farewell.
And what did you want to talk about?
I want to talk about Vendavel.
I want to talk about your work and the Chersonese in general.
I hope I can count on your help dealing with the fortress of Vendavel. It remains a deadly threat to Cierzo.

When it was just unorganized bandits squatting there, it was bad enough. Now we know that 3 warlords have begun to muster them into an army. I think they mean to attack Cierzo. If they do...I don't know if we can hold them off.
What do you recommend we do?

I honestly don't know. If we send any kind of force to go attack the fortress, we risk stirring the hornet's nest...Maybe if we could isolate and deal with each of the warlords separately we’d have a chance.
It would be very dangerous to infiltrate the fortress. Use discretion and caution. Messing with Vendavel might get you imprisoned and put to work as a slave, or worse.
Do you know who is organizing them?
I’ll take care of it.

One of them is a former warrior of mine, Crock. Exiled after he murdered two of my men in a drunken brawl five years ago. Another is a Kazite pirate captain whose description made even Eto wary...I think they know each other.

And lastly, there’s a lady mage who used to be part of one of Harmattan’s tribes. All 3 of them need to be dealt with. As long as any of these people are in play, an attack against Cierzo is inevitable. If you have to, kill them. They’re that much of a threat.
I want to talk about your work and the Chersonese in general.
I’ll take care of it.
What do you want to know?
Remember that the Fortress of Vendavel is a threat to the very existence of Cierzo. Be careful, [PlayerName].
Ah, [PlayerName], I am glad that you're back. We need all the help we can get. The Fortress of Vendavel has become a threat to Cierzo that’s too dire to ignore.
What are you up to, Warden?
What can you tell me about the Chersonese Region?
Farewell.
Waiting on some scouts to come back from reconnaissance. Up to date information on what’s happening in the surrounding region is essential to keeping Cierzo safe.
There's a bandit group I suspect is planning to attack us, and I want us to be prepared. I may be a skilled warrior, but against two dozen foes even I would be swept aside.
My warriors and I are the last line of defense for Cierzo. We decide what enters and what is driven from our walls. We bear the heaviest responsibility in this tribe.
There's several packs of hyenas to the North that are muscling into our hunting grounds. There are some nasty Troglodytes in the area too. I suspect they're jockeying for territory and prey.

Stay far away from the North-East in particular. I've heard rumors of a Scourge Beast, a Shelled Horror specifically, near the Ghost Pass. It’s probably just a rumor, but better safe than sorry, I say.
Don't forget that two other tribes are in open hostility to us right now. Be wary of the Montcalm tribe in the Northern Hills and the band of Kazite piratescoast.

Then there's the matter of several bandit crews deciding to join forces in the abandoned fortress, Vendavel along the southern coast. Stay well away from it. They’ve taken to enslaving anyone they capture.

Of course. If you favor 2-handed blades, but wish you had a more effective defense, I could teach you how to perform a Pommel Counter. It will allow you to confuse your foes and chain from defense to offense with style. How does 50 Silvers for a lesson sound?
Deal, here’s your money.
Farewell.

This requires careful timing. Hold the blade horizontal and on impact, strike back with the flat of the blade. Then, bash them swiftly with the pommel before they can react! They will be dazed and confused as you seamlessly return to the offense!
What’s got you worried?
I’ve noticed that the longer I stay out, the less maximum health and stamina I have.
How important is it to eat, drink and sleep?
How do I deal with dangerous temperatures?
What can you tell me about the Chersonese Region?
Pay attention to what your body tells you. As you push yourself, your maximum reserves of life and stamina will be diminished, and you will only be able to use a fraction of your normal maximum.

Sleeping in a tent or a bed will restore your reserves of stamina and life. Always be mindful of your limits and do not push them more than you need to. There is no shame in taking time to set up camp when you are exhausted.
Your body has needs. Hunger, thirst and exhaustion are persistent foes, so eat and drink when you need to. With a little preparation, you will find it easy enough to take care of yourself.

Rest is the best remedy for a wounded body. If your reserves of life and stamina are diminished or you are gravely injured, it’s a good idea to rest in a bedroll or a tent. You will feel much more capable after a good rest.
If you're near civilization, a night at the inn will take care of your needs in exchange for a little silver.

Be mindful of the weather and climate you travel in. When the cold rolls in, you should dress warmly and use campfires or torches for warmth. If you stay cold for too long you may get sick, and eventually freeze to death.
Alright, I feel comfortable letting you outside the walls. Use the door whenever you want to head out. Stay safe out there.
Well, you’ve got the essentials at least. Here, I'll teach you a skill. Mastering these is the key to survival out in the wild. Want me to teach you one for the weapon you’re currently holding?
Hold up there, [PlayerName]! Where do you think you’re going?
I’m going outside.
Not like that you aren't! You need at least an equipped weapon, a waterskin and an equipped backpack before you're ready to face the outside world.
If I let you adventure outside without even the most basic of equipment, you'd be marching to your own death. You're not heading out for a picnic!
If you're pressed to find a weapon, make yourself a quarterstaff from some tree wood. You can also craft a backpack, although I'm more than certain you have one lying around at home.
I'm also sure you can find a spare waterskin by the water purifier on the town beach. Don't forget to fill it up while you're there!
But I need to get out! My life depends on it!
Alright. I'll make sure I'm prepared before I head out.
And I can't let you out in this state. Your life also depends on it. I refuse to let someone needlessly be torn to shreds by a hyena or enslaved by pirates because they were unprepared!

Come back when you're seriously ready. And don't even think about using the storage tunnel under the lighthouse to sneak out! There's a pair of Troglodytes in there that we haven't had time to put down!

There you go! Mastering skills like this one is the key to survival out in the wild. You should look for Trainers whenever you visit a new town. Some are in the open in towns, near training equipment. Others need to be sought out and chatted with first.
Alright, I feel comfortable letting you outside the walls. Use the door whenever you want to head out. Stay safe out there.
Yes.
I think I want to learn one for a different weapon, give me a minute Burac.
